title: The practice continues
lesson: The 30 days were a structure, not a deadline. What you practiced does not stop being true today.
action: Notice one moment today where you used the practice without the app telling you to.

title: Some days still ask nothing
lesson: Not every day needs a lesson. Some days the work is just to keep living the one you already learned.
action: If nothing feels urgent today, that is not neglect. Check the tracker, then go on with your day.

title: Setbacks after day 30 are not a return to zero
lesson: A hard day now does not erase the thirty before it. You are not starting over. You are continuing with more evidence behind you.
action: If today is hard, name one thing from the program you still remember and use it.

title: You get to choose what stays
lesson: Not every technique landed the same way for you. Keep what worked. Let the rest go without guilt.
action: Name the one technique — Control, Amor Fati, View From Above, or Premeditatio — that has been most useful to you.

title: Check the record, not the feeling
lesson: A single bad day feels like proof of no progress. The record says otherwise.
action: Open View From Above in your tracker. Read the numbers, not the mood.

title: This is maintenance, not relapse
lesson: Coming back to this screen after weeks away is not failure. It is simply picking the tool back up when you need it.
action: Use one Right Now trigger today, even if nothing feels urgent — treat it as practice, not emergency use only.

title: The standard you set is still yours
lesson: Whatever you decided you would no longer accept, going forward — that standard does not expire because time passed.
action: Reread the line you wrote on day 22 or day 28, if you saved it. If not, write it again now.
